meta.source_records: Regional oncology + nephrology APS (~240 pp, 2022–2026); PCP records 2026
meta.summary_of_summary: 81M with hormone-sensitive nodal-metastatic prostate cancer in deep PSA response, progressive CKD 3b and compensated vascular disease.

overview.narrative: An 81-year-old man under active oncology and nephrology care. The clinical picture is dominated by recurrent prostate cancer with PSMA-PET nodal metastases, now hormone-sensitive on relugolix plus darolutamide with PSA 0.24. Renal function has drifted from creatinine 1.4 to 2.1 over four years (stage 3b, progressive). Cardiovascular disease is diffuse but compensated with a preserved ejection fraction. He is independent, never smoked, and drinks moderately.

problem_list: Coronary artery disease, asymptomatic; PAD; mild carotid disease

systems.title: Oncology (lead issue)
systems.narrative: Gleason 6 prostate cancer treated with prostatectomy in 2002, biochemical recurrence, and PSMA-PET nodal metastases in 2024.
bullets: Relugolix + darolutamide started 11/2024; PSA fell to 0.24 by 05/2026 (p. 41).
No visceral or bone metastases on the latest imaging (p. 52).

systems.title: Cardiovascular
bullets: PAD and mild carotid stenosis; BP controlled; LDL 67.

social_family: Family history: father died at 88; no premature cardiac disease.

le.method: Rubric v2.0: SSA 2023 baseline + 2.6-yr uplift, dominant-condition routing with the type-aware cancer anchor. Epidemiological approximation, not a prediction.
le.dominant: Rule R6 — active metastatic prostate cancer → individualized review. Prostate is a treatable-tier tumour (nodal/distant anchor ~5.5 × ECOG 1 ×1.1 × responding ×1.5 ≈ 9 yr ceiling), but at 81 the multiplicative factor with competing comorbidity governs below that ceiling.
factors: Node-only, hormone-sensitive, deep PSA response, ECOG 1 (pp. 39–41)
le.computation: Baseline 10.6 yr. Metastatic factor 0.42 + 0.08 (responding) = 0.50 → 5.3 yr; competing comorbidity (progressive CKD 3b, vascular disease) × ~0.85 → factor ≈ 0.42 → 4.4 yr. Absolute ceiling 9.1 yr does not bind. Credits cannot offset a dominant condition.
modules: SEER/ECOG cross-check: metastatic prostate, ECOG 1, hormone-sensitive — 5-yr survival ~30–35%; consistent with central ~4 yr.
Seattle HF, MELD 3.0, BODE: not applicable.
le.estimate: Estimated remaining life expectancy: roughly 3–6 years (to about age 84–87), central ~4 years.
le.swing_downside: (≤2 yr) castration resistance with rapid PSA doubling, visceral spread, or CKD progression toward dialysis.
le.swing_upside: (6+ yr) sustained hormone sensitivity with undetectable PSA and stable renal function.
le.accuracy_note: Active metastatic cancer is a lower-confidence category under Rubric §7; treatable-tier tumours in deep response can outlive the anchor.
le.caveat: Individualized estimate; treat as indicative and weight the records review.
